SYS_API_017_GET_RESPONSE.actionUniqueness: collectionActions and every availableActions array are unique by actionKey.
SYS_API_017_GET_RESPONSE.stableOrder: resourceType ascending, then automationKey for definitions or definitionPublicId plus versionNumber/schedulePublicId for other variants; the exact terminal sort tuple is cursor-bound.

SYS_API_017_POST_RESPONSE.description: The closed SYS-006 profile of the reused HrisCommandReceiptV1 wire object returned with 202. A replay may return the receipt's current closed status. aggregateVersion and resultRef are omitted until the durable positive-revision aggregate tuple exists; all other fields are required.
SYS_API_017_POST_RESPONSE.title: Sys006HrisCommandReceipt202V1

cancelEligibility.description: Owner-derived from the complete persisted effect and compensation set before pagination. ELIGIBLE_ALL_REQUIRED_PATHS means every uncertain effect has a trusted reconciliation path and every committed effect has an exact declared idempotent compensation path.

retryEligibleItemCount.description: Owner-derived count after exact current manifest mode, retryable receipt state, frozen selection integrity, dedupe evidence and both retry budgets are applied. It is zero outside PARTIAL or FAILED and never exceeds itemFailed.

SYS_API_019_GET_RESPONSE.stableOrder: attempts by attemptNumber ascending, items by itemSequence ascending and checkpoints by attemptNumber then checkpointOrdinal ascending; each next cursor binds its collection kind and terminal tuple.

catalogProjectionClosure.decisionRule: Field policy is evaluated independently for every returned resource and field. Visible, masked and omitted names are reflected in fieldDecisionSummary. An unrequested allowed field is OmittedField. If any projected business field in a row is MaskedField or OmittedField, availableActions is empty for that row; this conservative closed rule prevents state, identity or authorization inference and no hidden value is copied into a descriptor.
catalogProjectionClosure.queryRule: SYS-API-017 GET rejects any fields value outside allowedFields with 400. resourceType and availableActions are control fields and are always present; each requested or policy-controlled business field remains a required property whose value is either its visible scalar, MaskedField or OmittedField, so MASK/OMIT never violates the closed union.
catalogProjectionClosure.stableSortRule: Sorting and cursor binding use owner-side persisted values before projection. Masking or omission never changes the terminal tuple or leaks it through the cursor.

Fields.description: Closed SYS-API-017 catalog field-name set used by the query and field decision summary.

cursorBinding: Every cursor is authenticated and binds tenant ID, caller subject, owner-query ID, resource-type/filter digest, purpose, authorization revision, asOf, stable sort tuple and page limit. SYS-API-017 additionally binds the requested field set and field-policy revision. SYS-API-019 binds the invariant run-detail projection version and collection kind instead of accepting a field set. A mismatch, expiry or tamper returns 400 and never silently restarts pagination.

numericInteropRule.bigintStringRule: A signed-BIGINT value used in a JCS identity or digest beyond the safe-number domain is encoded as a no-leading-zero positive base-10 JSON string and parsed without coercion with an exact upper bound 9223372036854775807. Raw tenant IDs, database IDs and fence epochs never enter JSON/JCS as unsafe numbers.
numericInteropRule.numberRule: Every SYS-006 integer emitted as a JSON number, including API, PDX and event envelope revisions, versions and ordinals, is schema- and storage-bounded to 9007199254740991. Materialized item counts and item sequences are additionally bounded to canonical PDX-005 expectedItemCount 1000000000; attempt numbers remain bounded to 20.
numericInteropRule.signedDocumentRule: Every RFC-8785/JCS-signed definition, execution policy, handler manifest or schedule policy document applies the same number-or-decimal-string rule to versionNumber, objectRevision, handlerManifestRevision, compatibilityBaselineVersion, submittedSubjectRevision, approvedSubjectRevision and every nested integer token before signature verification.

runDetailProjectionClosure.actionRule: runPublicId and objectRevision are invariant control fields used to bind RETRY_RUN or CANCEL_RUN descriptors. Only RunActionArray is legal. retryEligibleItemCount and cancelEligibility are derived from the complete owner-side persisted item/effect set before pagination; the state, budget and eligibility schema is an executable upper bound, and authorization may only remove an otherwise eligible descriptor.
runDetailProjectionClosure.cursorRule: attempt, item and checkpoint cursors bind the invariant run-detail projection version, collection kind and terminal tuple. Empty arrays mean genuinely empty authorized collections and never encode field omission.
runDetailProjectionClosure.queryRule: SYS-API-019 does not accept fields. Its exact top-level and nested properties are invariant automation-control metadata after the route-level owner authorization decision; they are never individually MASKed, OMITted or inferred from a client field set.

schemaRule: These authoritative JSON-Schema-shaped fragments supersede the historical prose and obsolete monolithic AutomationCommand only for SYS-API-017 GET/POST and SYS-API-019. Every object has additionalProperties false; every nullable field in the newly owned catalog and run-detail responses is required and encoded as explicit null; the reused canonical HrisCommandReceiptV1 response alone preserves NON_NULL omission for its optional aggregateVersion and resultRef; optional query fields are omitted when absent; arrays preserve the stated stable order; and validation failure returns the existing closed Problem schema.
